an7.62:1.3: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave dīgharattaṃ iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpaṃ vipākaṃ paccanukūtaṃ
an7.62:1.5: satta vassāni mettacittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na yimaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ
an7.62:1.6: saṃvaṭṭamāne sudāhaṃ bhikkhave loke ābhassarupago homi
an7.62:2.1: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā homi mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī
an7.62:2.2: chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave sakko ahosiṃ devānamindo
an7.62:2.3: anekasatakkhattuṃ rājā ahosiṃ cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato
an7.62:2.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave imāni satta ratanāni ahesuṃ seyyathīdaṃ
an7.62:2.5: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthīratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ
an7.62:2.6: parosahassaṃ kho pana me bhikkhave puttā ahesuṃ sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā
an7.62:2.7: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasinti.
